meta.title: The Penguin and the Missing Nest

paragraphs: Leo drew a cartoon with six pictures for Explorers' Blog. It was about a small penguin on a planet with snow. Under each picture, he wrote one line. Mia read the lines, and Lily looked at the pictures. They read them one by one, from one to six.

Picture one. A small penguin lived on a white planet. He had a warm nest, and he loved it. He slept in it every night. Picture two. One morning, the nest was missing. The air was cold, and the sky was gray. The penguin looked in the snow and behind a big rock. He cried, "Where is my home?"

Picture three. He found a long red ski in the snow. It was a very old ski from a spaceship. Picture four. A strong wind came, and it pushed him down the hill. The penguin stood on the ski and went very fast. He was not afraid, and he laughed.

Picture five. The ski stopped next to a lot of old bags and bottles. A spaceship left them there. The nest was under the bags, and it was dirty. The bags were gray, and the bottles were green. Picture six. Two more penguins came with big bags. The penguin and his friends cleaned the snow. They put the bags and bottles in a big bin. The work took all day. Now the planet was clean, and the nest was warm again.

At the end, Leo wrote, "Keep your environment clean!" "Is the penguin a ski star?" asked Mia. "Yes, and he is a good friend of the planet," said Leo. "I drew him in one hour," he said. "I want to be his friend," said Mia. Lily laughed and said, "I like picture five, because it tells a lot." Do you want to see the penguin on the blog?
